metadata.description: Codex App plugins by Jacky Zhang. Includes FormBro (Canadian immigration form automation), EasyBooks (bookkeeping for self-employed Canadians), and future tools.

plugins.description: Canadian immigration form automation: read/write applications, persons, employers; fill IRCC IMM PDFs; drive local webform fills via the bundled FormBro CLI.
plugins.name: formbro

plugins.description: Bookkeeping for self-employed Canadians via the bundled EasyBooks CLI: drop a receipt, invoice, or scan Gmail and have it recorded into EasyBooks. The CLI is the only boundary for all EasyBooks reads and writes — record income/expenses, create and send invoices, and resolve clients/categories.
plugins.name: easybooks

plugins.description: Query and export your own local chat archive (friends, groups, attachments, voice WAV) via the bundled AnyChat CLI. Free Portal token; content stays on your machine.
plugins.name: anychat

plugins.description: Canadian Immigration Intelligence & Practical Tools: Federal Court precedents, IRCC policy, practitioner field notes, and CLB conversion via the bundled AnyImmi CLI.
plugins.name: anyimmi

plugins.description: Inspect a messy local document folder and assemble an approved upload pack via the bundled AnyDoc CLI. Offline packing. Optional Portal token for private models and Tell Jacky. macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
plugins.name: anydoc

plugins.description: Secure agent-native PDF form filling, one-shot intake, and Tell-Jacky feedback.
plugins.name: anypdf
anyweb
plugins.description: Check AnyWeb repair claims, connect once with the shared Portal credential, and Tell Jacky.
